title: David Georgio
summary: Marcus Georgio's son and a rogue operative in Compromised's Gulf Coast plot.

claims.text: Compromised identifies David Georgio as a rogue operative working with the cell manipulating the Gulf Coast conflict.
The rogue cell uses David's apparent captivity to force his father, Marcus Georgio, to move the Molossi into refinery communities.

paragraphs.text: David's position inside the rogue operation turns him into the pressure point used to control Marcus Georgio and, through him, the Molossi.

verification.notes: The book identifies David's rogue role and its coercive use; detailed first-wave history is not expanded here.
